messages:
Ana: Quick sync — Q3 decision needed. We have a strong customer ask (FinCorp pilot) pushing for the Fastpath feature, but infra debt (runtime memory fragmentation + KV cache) will start regressing cost/latency in 4–6 weeks. We can't staff both fully. Thoughts on sequencing?
Sam: My read: impact vs risk. Fastpath -> immediate revenue/renewal signal, but if infra worsens we degrade all customers. Propose a two-lane plan with strict scopes.
Mira: Agree two lanes. Suggest we use an "impact-velocity" score instead of raw RICE this time — velocity = how many sprints to get safe MVP + docs + canary.
Priya: Sales is explicit: FinCorp will sign pilot if integrated by end of sprint 3. So customer deadline is fixed.
Kevin: If we commit to FinCorp timeline we need a runtime hotfix now: KV cache eviction tweak + 1-day perf pass. That buys ~6 weeks. We can parallelize limited infra work later.
Sam: Concrete proposal: split 60/40 for next 3 sprints (60% eng to Fastpath MVP for 2 top customers; 40% to infra core: cache + mem fix). Limit Fastpath scope to: no multi-tenant rollout, single-tenant config, feature-flagged.
Mira: For prioritization matrix, I'm scoring: Fastpath: impact 9, velocity 3 (3 sprints), risk 4. Infra: impact 7, velocity 2 (2 sprints), risk 6. Not pure numbers but helps explain tradeoffs.
Kevin: We can reduce infra risk by shipping a fallback path: on excess latency route to smaller model + circuit breaker. Rollout policy example:
```json
{"rollout":"canary","initial_pct":10,"step_pct":20,"monitor":"p50_latency,p99_error"}
```
Sam: Nice. Also add an ops SLA gate: if p99 error > 1% for 10m, auto-rollback.
Priya: Launch criteria (minimum) for Fastpath pilot: onboarding < 15min, p50 latency < 350ms, p99 < 1.2s, pilot NPS >= 7 (qual survey). If any fail, we hold.
Ana: OK — decision to proceed with 60/40 split with scoping limits and launch gates. We need a weekly handshake between lanes. Who owns triage?
Kevin: I'll own triage for infra side. Happy to take weekly sync. :raised_hands:
Sam: I'll lead Fastpath delivery. I'll add a 10% buffer each sprint for unblock tickets and cross-team ops.
ops-bot: Automated capacity snapshot: available dev-weeks this quarter: 42. Planned allocation: Fastpath 25, Infra 17.
Mira: Request: record these decisions on the initiative doc and add the gate checklist so QA/CS know hold criteria.
Ana: Action items: 1) Sam: post trimmed Fastpath scope doc by EOD, 2) Kevin: perf-hotfix PR by tomorrow, 3) Priya: align FinCorp expectations to gated launch. We'll revisit at next weekly sync. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Got it.
Priya: On it, will message FinCorp with gating language.
Kevin: PR target set.
Mira: I'll update the initiative board and add the impact-velocity scores.
Ana: Thanks all — closing thread.
